skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding General Concepts of Agricultural Business Management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand general concepts such as characteristics of agricultural production affecting business management, types of organizational structures in agricultural business management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Strategic and Planning Aspects of Agricultural Business Management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students comprehend strategic and planning aspects including organization of resource utilization and product consumption in agricultural business management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Financial Management and Accounting in Agricultural Business Management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students grasp financial management and accounting principles in agricultural business management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and Building Strategies for Agricultural Businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can analyze and build strategies for agricultural businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Organizing Resource Utilization in Agricultural Businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have skills in organizing resource utilization in agricultural businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Organizing Product Consumption in Agricultural Businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have skills in organizing product consumption in agricultural businesses.
Students improve their ability to learn independently, conduct research, and present findings.
Students develop the ability to assess the quality of their work after completion.
